name: model-router
description: Route and delegate coding tasks through a privacy-safe local model router.

interface.shortDescription: Choose and delegate across local model providers.
interface.longDescription: Use a local compatibility proxy and MCP tools to choose models, delegate bounded tasks, explain routing decisions, and record outcome feedback without storing raw prompts by default.
defaultPrompt: Choose the best model for this coding task.
Delegate this bounded task through my router.
Explain the last model routing decision.
